map.输入锥体底面积 A 与高度 h，按 V=A·h/3 计算锥体体积，适用于土石方、: Enter pyramid base area A and height h; compute volume by V = A*h/3, suited to earthwork/fill pile volumes approximated as cones, e.g., quick estimation of spoil heaps and material piles.
map.输入底面积 A 与高 h，求锥体体积。: Enter base area A and height h to find pyramid volume.
map.堆体（锥/棱锥）体积估 1/3 底面积×高。: Pile (cone/pyramid) volume estimated as 1/3 * base area * height.
map.：底面积 100 m²、高 9m → V=1/3×100×9=300 m³；土堆: : base area 100 m2, height 9 m -> V=1/3*100*9=300 m3; quick estimate for earth piles/fill.
map.：同底高柱体 900 m³，锥仅 1/3，堆体勿按柱算否则高估 3 倍。: : same-base-height prism 900 m3, cone only 1/3; do not compute piles as prisms or you overestimate 3x.
